blurb: an alternate governance kit: draft a charter, let sortition draw a fresh council every round, run a doge-style lot-and-ballot election for a rotating facilitator, and tally votes with an AI delegate's heuristic take in the room — scales from a 3-person co-op to a 200-person commons. asked for by shimmermathlabs.com.
